## Core Project Experience

### Full-Stack Web Applications
Building scalable web applications using React, Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, and modern SQL/NoSQL databases with clean architecture, authentication, and optimized performance.

### Enterprise & Business Platforms
Developing recruitment systems, educational platforms, portfolio websites, content management solutions, and business dashboards with secure backend services and intuitive user experiences.

### AI-Powered Applications
Integrating large language models (LLMs), document processing, intelligent search, resume builders, AI assistants, and workflow automation into production-ready web applications.

### API & Database Engineering
Designing secure RESTful APIs, implementing authentication systems, managing relational and NoSQL databases, optimizing queries, and building scalable backend services.

### Web3 Development
Experience building decentralized applications (dApps), integrating wallets, developing Solidity smart contracts, and working with Ethereum-compatible ecosystems including Foundry and Hardhat.
